svg.text: Each shown big, in the site header, and on the night theme. All original: no Telegram or TON marks.

text.tspan: The site's mascot as the logo. Friendly,
A toggle switched on, with a G for its knob:
A G whose bar is a bonding curve shooting up
The curve rising to a coin at the top: every
A wGRAM coin taking off: the classic
Today's wGRAM logo: a coin with a dashed
